title_en: Famous Restaurants (3/20): Lanzhou's Century-Old Noodle Shop
note_en: 只有…才… means "only if… then…": 只有掌握了…正确的比例，才能拉出又细又不断的面条 "Only by mastering the right ratio can you pull noodles that are thin yet don't break." 只有 names the one necessary condition and 才 must come before the verb in the result clause, much as English "only…can" triggers inverted word order.

sentences.en: According to historical research, the prototype of Lanzhou beef noodles was created by Ma Baozi in 1915, who refined the rough "hot-pot noodles" of the time into clear-broth pulled noodles; today the Lanzhou Beef Noodle Association has standardized the broth recipe, requiring the stock to be simmered for a long time from beef bones and more than twenty spices.
